sermon.title: The Part of God That Empowers Mankind on Earth
sermon.speaker: Pastor David G. Kincer
sermon.summary: Pastor David G. Kincer teaches that the Holy Spirit is the part of God that empowers mankind on earth to succeed in natural, spiritual and family areas. He traces the Spirit through the Old Testament—creation, Noah, Joseph, Bezalel, the seventy elders, Balaam, Joshua, the judges, Saul and David—showing the Spirit empowers but does not make anyone infallible, and can be lost.
sermon.transcript_source: This transcript comes from YouTube’s automatic English captions, which supply the timing and the words. Punctuation, capitalization and paragraphing were added from the speaker’s pauses and then corrected by hand, and obvious caption errors (names, Bible references) were fixed; his wording was not rewritten. “[unclear]” marks a word or name that was not clear. Editor notes: Name caption fixes: Amasai, Bezalel, Othniel. Points to check: he says the seventy elders agreed to go back to Egypt and make the golden calf (Exodus 32 doesn’t name them); “the New Testament is 90 Old Testament quotations” and Samson carrying the gates 50 miles are unchecked; he cites 1 Timothy 1:5 for Jesus coming to save sinners (likely 1:15). Sensitive content kept as spoken: capital punishment, welfare, prophecy for money in spirit-filled churches, Jesus taking no money, losing the Spirit/Hebrews 6.

faqs.question: Where is heaven?
faqs.answer: He says heaven is the spirit world right here; if our eyes were opened we could see the angels here today.

faqs.question: Is the Old Testament for today?
faqs.answer: Yes—Jesus and the apostles quoted it constantly, and things in it were written for our learning.

faqs.question: What is “faith in your faith”?
faqs.answer: Believing you have the Holy Ghost or are saved just because you believe it, without God being active.

faqs.question: What does God most want to do when he comes?
faqs.answer: Speak—teach and improve us; the word sets you free and causes you to grow.

faqs.question: Does God care about your natural success?
faqs.answer: Yes—recognize and strengthen your natural abilities and God will bless you financially.

faqs.question: Can believers prophesy today?
faqs.answer: Yes—speaking edification, exhortation and comfort and the mighty works of God.

faqs.question: Did Jesus charge for ministry?
faqs.answer: He says Jesus and the apostles never took money for healing the sick or preaching.

faqs.question: Should we elevate ministers God uses?
faqs.answer: Give honor where due, but never adore or lift up a person; Jesus must be lifted up.

faqs.question: Should Christians be involved in government?
faqs.answer: Yes—know about government and vote on moral and truth principles.

faqs.question: Can someone excuse sin by saying they are like David?
faqs.answer: No—David repented and never did it again.
